clientScopes.name: supplier-risk:submit

clientScopes.name: supplier-risk:retry
clientScopes.description: PAD-002 canonical scope -- Supplier Risk retry (not granted to the primary demo persona).

clientScopes.name: supplier-risk:replay
clientScopes.description: PAD-002 canonical scope -- Supplier Risk replay (not granted to the primary demo persona).

clientScopes.name: entity-resolution:read
clientScopes.description: PAD-002 canonical scope -- Entity Resolution read access.

clientScopes.name: entity-resolution:decide
clientScopes.description: PAD-002 canonical scope -- Entity Resolution decide (not granted to the primary demo persona).

clientScopes.name: ontology-modeling:propose
clientScopes.description: CDD-028 canonical scope -- Governed Visual Ontology Modeling propose authority (not granted to the primary demo persona).

clientScopes.name: ontology-modeling:approve
clientScopes.description: CDD-028 canonical scope -- Governed Visual Ontology Modeling approve/reject authority (not granted to the primary demo persona).

clientScopes.name: ontology-modeling:publish
clientScopes.description: CDD-028 canonical scope -- Governed Visual Ontology Modeling publish authority (not granted to the primary demo persona).

clientScopes.name: ontology-copilot:ask
clientScopes.description: PAD-002 canonical scope -- Ask CTEC.

clientScopes.name: supply-chain-impact:read
clientScopes.description: PAD-003 SS2a canonical scope -- Gate F Supply Chain Impact read access (granted to the primary demo persona, PAD-003 SS9).

clientScopes.name: supply-chain-impact:evaluate
clientScopes.description: PAD-003 SS2b canonical scope -- Gate F governed evaluation (granted to the primary demo persona, PAD-003 SS9 F5.1 correction; not approval or execution authority).

clientScopes.name: information-element-evidence-fitness:read
clientScopes.description: CDD-034 canonical scope -- Governed Evidence Fitness Exposure read access.

clientScopes.name: information-element-context:read
clientScopes.description: CDD-029 canonical scope -- Governed Blueprint Information-Element Context-as-a-Service read access.

clientScopes.name: ontology-modeling:read
clientScopes.description: CDD-028 canonical scope -- Governed Visual Ontology Modeling read/list/view authority (non-consequential; granted to the primary demo persona).

clientScopes.name: tool-execution:execute
clientScopes.description: CDD-035 canonical scope -- Governed Tool Execution invocation authority (not granted to the primary demo persona).

clientScopes.name: governed-approval:request
clientScopes.description: CDD-036 canonical scope -- Governed Human Approval request/execute authority (not granted to the primary demo persona).

clientScopes.name: governed-approval:decide
clientScopes.description: CDD-036 canonical scope -- Governed Human Approval decide (approve/reject) authority (not granted to the primary demo persona).

clientScopes.name: governed-agent:propose
clientScopes.description: CDD-037 canonical scope -- Governed Agent Resolution proposal authority (not granted to the primary demo persona).

clientScopes.name: oqi:read
clientScopes.description: CDD-045 canonical scope -- Ontology Quality Intelligence read authority (Command Center, Findings, evidence, ontology/business impact, Reliance, agent investigation, remediation state). Default-granted.

clientScopes.name: oqi-remediation:authorize
clientScopes.description: CDD-045 canonical scope -- OQI governed remediation human-authorization (approve/reject) authority, mirroring governed-approval:decide's two-scope pattern (not granted to the primary demo persona by default).

clientScopes.name: oqi-remediation:report-execution
clientScopes.description: CDD-045 canonical scope -- OQI governed external-remediation report-execution authority, mirroring governed-approval:request's two-scope pattern (not granted to the primary demo persona by default).

clientScopes.name: oqi-reference-evidence:configure
clientScopes.description: CDD-048 canonical scope -- OQI-H2 governed Reference Evidence configuration authority (governed dataset / business-rule-derived assertions). Never substitutable by :verify or any remediation scope; not granted to the primary demo persona by default.

clientScopes.name: oqi-reference-evidence:verify
clientScopes.description: CDD-048 canonical scope -- OQI-H2 governed human-verification authority for Reference Evidence (PO-03). Never substitutable by :configure or any remediation scope; not granted to the primary demo persona by default.

clientScopes.name: oqi-canonical-standard:configure
clientScopes.description: CDD-049 canonical scope -- OQI-H3 governed CanonicalStandard configuration authority (create/version/retire canonical values/aliases). Never substitutable by remediation or reference-evidence scopes; not granted to the primary demo persona by default.
